content_html:
“Unfortunately, Doug Seven cancelled by Blackbelt Software Configuration Management breakout session in the development practices track because I don’t use Team System.”

Now *that* is lame. Why is SVN persona non grata?

Wow. I suspected TechEd was more about marketing than training, but didn’t realize they were so explicit about it. I feel better about saving my company’s money on it.
Glad to hear your NHibernate session escaped the censors. Good luck – hope you get a good turnout.
